note: No [[identity.partition]]: the declared split 1.5.kon names the native family's columns implicitly, and three spellings of one column that are never delivered together in one year fold onto it: Kon and KON differ by case, Kön by a diacritic (the replaced Kön/Kon test). The replaced Kön/Kon test is named for distinct spellings that do not bind, but its one surviving parameter asserts that they do.
fails_if: `convert_column_partitions` matches the split suffix against column names case-sensitively, or treats non-co-delivered case twins as competing literals, so KON (or Kon) stays on the unnamed native family; or `fold_column` stops stripping diacritics (lowercase only), so Kön and Kon count as two literals and the whole kon split stays unresolved

sources.description: Variable 5 delivers column Kon in 2020 (CVID 20), KON in 2021 (CVID 21) and Kön in 2022 (CVID 22).
